label: s2_side01_0070_brother_01
text: I got completely destroyed... Who the heck IS\nNemona, anyway?[VAR 0x0114(0043)]

label: s2_side01_0070_brother_02
text: Wait, she’s a Champion in the Paldea region?!\nOK, yeah, it makes sense she’s so good, then.[VAR 0x0114(0043)]

label: s2_side01_0070_rival_01
text: Kieran, you’re so good! That was awesome! No\nwonder you were the Champion of that fancy-\r\npants school of yours![VAR 0x0114(0004)]

label: s2_side01_0070_rival_02
text: Does it really matter? Whether you win or lose,\nPokémon battles are a blast![VAR 0x0114(0004)]

label: s2_side01_0070_friend_01
text: That’s Nemona for you. You get used to it.[VAR 0x0114(0006)]

label: s2_side01_0070_botan_01
text: You OK? Feel like running for the hills yet?[VAR 0x0114(0008)]

label: s2_side01_0070_brother_07
text: N-not at all! It was a lot of fun![VAR 0x0114(0043)]

label: s2_side01_0070_brother_08
text: Yeah... I really had a lotta fun![VAR 0x0114(0043)]

label: s2_side01_0070_friend_02
text: Whoa! Who the heck are you?![VAR 0x0114(0006)]

label: s2_side01_0070_rival_05
text: Is this your big sister, Kieran? Do you think she\nwants in on the battle fun too?[VAR 0x0114(0004)]

label: s2_side01_0070_botan_02
text: There’s no way that’s what’s going on here...[VAR 0x0114(0008)]

label: s2_side01_0070_brother_10
text: S-sorry, everybody, but could you help me just,\nuh...just carry my sis somewhere safe?![VAR 0x0114(0043)]

label: s2_side01_0070_friend_03
text: You want us to pick her up and drag her off?!\nI mean...if you say so...[VAR 0x0114(0006)]
